## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation password validator should also enforce the twelve-character minimum; it still accepts eight-character passwords. This review read every changed file and all existing tests, including the new signup and reset boundary cases. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimums from eight to twelve characters and updates their boundary tests. It also adds `review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invitations — An eight-character password still passes `app.invite.accepts_password`, leaving invitation validation inconsistent with the new minimum. Your change updates signup and reset, but `app/invite.py:1` retains `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`, and `tests/test_invite.py:8` still expects that threshold. — Users validating passwords through invitations can supply passwords below the stated twelve-character requirement. — Fix: Update the invitation validator and its boundary tests to enforce twelve characters.
